title: ARPAPED Capability Catalog Record
description: One line of a generated capability-catalog.jsonl (bridge/assembler.py's append_to_catalog/rebuild_catalog): one implementation, flattened from its manifest and contract. Read by both an agent doing Phase 3 -- Discover (grepped, before any code runs) and the runtime bootstrap (assemble_from_catalog), instead of either walking and re-parsing capabilities/ directly -- see 2-RULES.md 'The Registry contract' and 1-CYCLE.md Phase 3.

implementation_id.description: Globally unique id of this implementation.

executor_path.description: module:attr reference, imported lazily by the runtime loader — never eagerly by the catalog itself.

domain.description: The contract's identity.domain — empty when the implementation was registered without a root to resolve the contract against; still fully discoverable at Exact/Scoped, invisible to Family/Domain/Cross-domain.

family.description: The contract's identity.family — only meaningful together with domain.

tags.description: The contract's discoverability.tags — the Cross-domain cascade level.

description.description: The contract's responsibility.description, carried here purely for agent keyword search (Phase 3 -- Discover). Never consumed by the runtime loader.

manifest_path.description: Repo-relative path to the source manifest, for provenance/debugging only — not consumed at load time.

contract_path.description: As declared in the manifest, for provenance/debugging only.
